# 📋 Task Tracker — FullStack Kanban & Todo Manager

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.1.0-blue.svg)
![Django](https://img.shields.io/badge/Django-5.0+-092E20.svg?logo=django)
![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18.3+-61DAFB.svg?logo=react)
![pnpm](https://img.shields.io/badge/pnpm-9.0+-F69220.svg?logo=pnpm)
![PWA](https://img.shields.io/badge/PWA-Ready-5A0FC8.svg)

Task Tracker is a modern, responsive full-stack task management application featuring a visual single-page **Kanban board**. Built with a **Django REST Framework** backend and a **React + Vite** frontend, it supports native HTML5 drag-and-drop, Light/Dark mode themes, custom brand favicon icons, and offline Progressive Web App (PWA) capabilities.

---

## ✨ Features

- 🎯 **Visual Kanban Board**: Track tasks across 4 columns (`To Do`, `In Progress`, `Review`, `Done`).
- ✋ **Native Drag & Drop**: Smooth HTML5 browser drag and drop (zero third-party drag libraries).
- 🌓 **Dark & Light Mode**: Seamless theme switching with persistent user preference in `localStorage`.
- 📝 **Full Task CRUD**: Create, edit, delete, and view task details with priority badges (`Low`, `Medium`, `High`).
- ⚡ **Optimistic UI Updates**: Immediate client state updates with REST API synchronization.
- 📱 **Progressive Web App (PWA)**: Standalone web app installation and Service Worker static caching.
- 🚀 **RESTful Django API**: Django REST Framework backend with SQLite database and initial seed scripts.

---

## 🛠️ Technology Stack

- **Backend**: Python 3.10+, Django 5.x, Django REST Framework 3.15+, `django-cors-headers`, SQLite.
- **Frontend**: React 18/19, Vite, `pnpm`, Lucide React (icons), Vanilla CSS Design System.
- **PWA & Branding**: Web App Manifest (`manifest.webmanifest`), Service Worker (`sw.js`), Custom SVG/ICO Favicons.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start Guide

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.10 or higher
- Node.js 18+ & `pnpm` (`npm i -g pnpm`)

---

### 1. Setup Backend (Django REST API)

```bash
# Navigate to workspace directory
cd backend

# Install Python dependencies
pip install django djangorestframework django-cors-headers

# Run database migrations
python manage.py migrate

# Seed sample tasks into SQLite database
python manage.py seed_tasks

# Start Django backend server (runs at http://127.0.0.1:8000)
python manage.py runserver 8000
```

---

### 2. Setup Frontend (React + Vite)

```bash
# Navigate to client directory
cd client

# Install frontend dependencies using pnpm
pnpm install

# Start Vite React development server (runs at http://localhost:3000)
pnpm dev
```

---

## 📡 API Reference

Base Endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/tasks/`

| HTTP Method | Route | Description | Sample Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/tasks/` | Fetch all tasks | — |
| `POST` | `/api/tasks/` | Create a task | `{"title": "Task 1", "status": "TODO", "priority": "HIGH"}` |
| `GET` | `/api/tasks/{id}/` | Get task by ID | — |
| `PATCH` | `/api/tasks/{id}/` | Update task status or fields | `{"status": "IN_PROGRESS"}` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/tasks/{id}/` | Delete task | — |

---

## 🎨 Theme & Customization

The app features CSS Custom Properties in `client/src/index.css` supporting automatic system theme detection (`prefers-color-scheme`) and manual toggle between Light and Dark mode.
